novel_mechanics_found: Level 2 introduces a second, dark-headed vertical manipulator holding a red/green segmented column of colored blocks. Blocks on that helper cannot be pulled horizontally in the ordinary way. A horizontal contact followed by perpendicular vertical motion detaches and carries the contacted block; a carried block pushed into the anchored column can displace lower blocks, so solving requires two-arm transfer, collision clearance, and removal of the cyan decoy before delivering gray-maroon-white.
narrative: The 44-action banked prefix replayed from reset and reached level 2, and the final reproduce() gate independently passed for claimed level 2. I explored the next level through rendered frames only. Earlier levels use a sticky telescoping horizontal arm to sort blocks into the bottom-strip order, but level 2 adds an anchored vertical helper and a cyan decoy; I established how to detach gray and how carried blocks displace the helper's column, but did not complete the required gray-maroon-white sort. I stopped after the reserved reproduction gate rather than claim an unobserved level-up.
gotchas: Rendered action results may contain a stack of animation frames; use the final 64x64 frame for the current visual state.
ACTION1/ACTION2 move the magenta horizontal manipulator vertically; ACTION4 extends its arm and ACTION3 retracts it. ACTION5 and ACTION6 were observed no-ops on level 2.
An extension stops immediately before a block; retraction pulls only when contact has actually been established, and required extension count depends on the block's horizontal distance.
On level 2, the tiny dark cap and red/green vertical segments are active mechanics, not decoration: they form a second manipulator that anchors the colored column.

A block anchored to the vertical helper can be detached by contacting it horizontally and then moving the horizontal manipulator perpendicular to the helper; collision with intervening anchored blocks can block vertical motion or displace the lower column.
